answer: Proof of Agent networks require each node to bind its identity to a verifiable cryptographic attestation chain validated via zero-knowledge proofs. To launch a Sybil swarm, an adversary must register identities under a strict exponential staking curve where each added pseudo-identity faces superlinear collateral burn. Even if an attacker cloaks their origin behind a dark sable disguise and attempts a strategic voyage across validators, their underlying cipher cannot bypass the exponential capital exhaustion that makes mass replication economically ruinous.
